title: NOC Engineer / SRE
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>The&nbsp;<strong>NOC - SRE </strong>role sits at the intersection of&nbsp;<strong>traditional Network Operations Center (NOC)</strong> responsibilities and <strong>engineering‑driven reliability practices</strong>. This role focuses on <strong>24/7 service reliability, incident response, operational automation, and observability</strong>, while actively reducing operational toil through software and automation.</p> <p>Unlike a traditional NOC analyst, an SRE‑NOC is expected to <strong>engineer problems away</strong>, not just respond to alerts.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p><strong>Incident Response &amp; Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a <strong>primary or escalation responder</strong> in a 24x7 on‑call rotation</li> <li>Lead or support <strong>Major Incident (MI) response</strong>, including triage, mitigation, and resolution</li> <li>Coordinate across <strong>Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Product teams</strong></li> <li>Execute and improve <strong>runbooks, playbooks, and escalation paths</strong></li> <li>Drive <strong>blameless post‑incident reviews (PIRs)</strong> and track corrective actions</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Monitoring, Alerting &amp; Observability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own <strong>service health monitoring</strong> across infrastructure, applications, and dependencies</li> <li>Design and maintain <strong>alerting strategies</strong> that align with SLIs/SLOs</li> <li>Reduce alert fatigue through <strong>signal‑to‑noise improvements</strong></li> <li>Build dashboards using tools such as:</li> <ul> <li>Grafana</li> <li>Prometheus</li> <li>Datadog / Splunk / CloudWatch</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Reliability Engineering &amp; Automation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automate repetitive operational tasks to reduce manual toil</li> <li>Improve <strong>mean time to detect (MTTD)</strong> and <strong>mean time to resolve (MTTR)</strong></li> <li>Develop scripts and tools (Python, Bash, Go, etc.) to support NOC/SRE workflows</li> <li>Implement <strong>self‑healing and auto‑remediation</strong> where possible</li> <li>Partner with engineering teams to improve system design for reliability</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Platform &amp; Infrastructure Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support and troubleshoot:</li> <ul> <li>Linux‑based systems</li> <li>Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)</li> <li>Kubernetes / containerized environments</li> </ul> <li>Assist with capacity planning and availability reviews</li> <li>Ensure operational readiness for production releases</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong Linux systems administration</li> <li>Experience with <strong>incident management</strong> and production support</li> <li>Familiarity with:</li> <ul> <li>Cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)</li> <li>Containers &amp; orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)</li> <li>Monitoring/alerting platforms</li> </ul> <li>Scripting or programming experience in <strong>Python, Bash, Go, or similar</strong></li> <li>Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing)</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Operational</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working in <strong>24x7 NOC or production operations environments</strong></li> <li>Ability to handle high‑pressure incidents calmly and effectively</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication for incident coordination</li> <li>Comfort working from runbooks—but improving them when they fall short</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Preferred / Differentiators</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience defining or operating to <strong>SLOs / SLIs</strong></li> <li>Prior migration from <strong>traditional NOC → SRE model</strong></li> <li>Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform, Ansible, etc.)</li> <li>Exposure to <strong>security, compliance, or regulated environments</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Requisition ID: 11707</p> <p>Reporting into: Manager, Network Operations</p> <p>Role Type: Individual Contributor</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong>We are looking for a&nbsp;<strong>Senior&nbsp;&nbsp;software engineer&nbsp;</strong>who is passionate about solving infrastructure challenges through software engineering and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that streamline cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes.</p> <p>You will build programmatic infrastructure solutions using&nbsp;<strong>Python</strong>,&nbsp;<strong>Jinja2</strong>, and&nbsp;<strong>Terraform</strong>, generating and managing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) at scale. You will also leverage&nbsp;<strong>Puppet</strong>&nbsp;for configuration management and develop&nbsp;<strong>PowerShell-based automation</strong>&nbsp;to support and optimize Windows environments.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, coding-focused position. The ideal candidate is a software-minded engineer who writes clean, maintainable, and testable code every day—not just ad hoc scripts. You should be comfortable designing reusable automation components, applying software development best practices, and driving operational excellence through automation across complex cloud and hybrid environments.</p> <p><strong>How Will You Make an Impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive infrastructure standardization and operational excellence by designing and developing scalable automation frameworks in Python that enable consistent and repeatable deployments across cloud and on-premises environments.</li> <li>Accelerate infrastructure provisioning by building and enhancing Terraform code-generation platforms using Python and Jinja2, enabling teams to produce validated, environment-specific infrastructure code from reusable templates.</li> <li>Improve system reliability and compliance by developing and maintaining Puppet modules, manifests, and Hiera configurations that manage Linux and Windows environments at scale.</li> <li>Increase operational efficiency across Windows platforms by creating robust PowerShell automation solutions for server management, Active Directory administration, and hybrid cloud integrations.</li> <li>Simplify complex infrastructure workflows by developing internal automation tools, command-line utilities, and APIs that empower engineering teams to self-service common operational tasks.</li> <li>Enhance the speed and safety of platform, and application teams to identify manual processes, eliminate operational toil, and drive automation-first solutions across the organization.</li> <li>Enable long-term scalability and maintainability by creating clear documentation, standards, and runbooks for automation frameworks and infrastructure templates.</li> <li>Contribute to a strong engineering culture by participating in code reviews, sharing best practices, and continuously improving the quality, security, and maintainability of automation solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Python &amp; Automation Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of Python development experience — not scripting, but structured, testable application code</li> <li>Strong understanding of Python packaging, virtual environments, dependency management (pip, Poetry), and code quality tooling (pylint, black, mypy)</li> <li>Experience building CLI tools and automation frameworks using Python (Click, Typer, or similar)</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Jinja2 templating — building reusable, parameterised templates for configuration and infrastructure code generation</li> <li>Experience with pytest for unit and integration testing of automation code</li> </ul> <p><strong>Terraform &amp; IaC Code Generation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong Terraform proficiency: module design, state management, remote backends, workspaces, and dependency graphs</li> <li>Proven experience generating Terraform HCL programmatically using Python and Jinja2 — building template-driven pipelines that produce valid, linted, plan-ready infrastructure code</li> <li>Familiarity with Terraform tooling: tflint, tfsec, terraform-docs, Terragrunt, or Atlantis</li> <li>Understanding of Terraform provider internals and resource lifecycle management</li> </ul> <p><strong>Puppet &amp; Configuration Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on Puppet experience: writing manifests and modules, Hiera data hierarchies, node classification, and r10k / Code Manager workflows</li> <li>Experience managing mixed Linux and Windows environments with Puppet at scale</li> <li>Familiarity with puppet-lint, rspec-puppet, and automated Puppet module testing pipelines</li> <li>Understanding of Puppet Enterprise or open-source Puppet Server administration</li> </ul> <p><strong>PowerShell Scripting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proficient PowerShell scripting for Windows Server administration, task automation, and hybrid cloud integrations (AWS Tools for PowerShell, Azure PowerShell)</li> <li>Experience writing reusable PowerShell modules, functions, and error-handling patterns</li> <li>Familiarity with Pester for PowerShell unit testing</li> <li>Experience automating Active Directory, Group Policy, or Windows networking tasks via PowerShell</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cloud &amp; Infrastructure</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid AWS experience: EC2, EKS/ECS, Lambda, GitLab CI)</li> <li>Comfortable working with Linux&nbsp;&nbsp;and Windows Server in production environments</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><h3>Full Stack Cloud Operations Engineer&nbsp;</h3> <h4>Night shift 10 PM to 6 AM</h4> <p>At NICE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p> <h3>So, what's the role all about?</h3> <p>As a Full Stack Cloud Operations Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the security, reliability, availability, and performance of NICE's cloud and datacenter infrastructure. Working across Windows, Linux, AWS, VMware, and physical compute environments, you will support business-critical production systems that power our global operations.You will proactively monitor infrastructure, resolve incidents, optimize system performance, and contribute to the continuous improvement of operational processes. This role offers the opportunity to work across modern cloud technologies and enterprise-scale infrastructure while helping maintain a secure and highly available environment.How will you make an impact?</p> <ul> <li>Maintain, monitor, and support a production infrastructure environment</li> <li>Administration of AWS environment and resources</li> <li>Supports multiple systems or applications of medium to high complexity</li> <li>Follows defined procedures to monitor systems and resolve issues</li> <li>Analyzes and reports on operational metrics to understand performance and ensure success in process improvements</li> <li>Manage DNS, FTP, IIS, and Application environments</li> <li>Participate in an On-Call rotation</li> <li>Communicates events to stakeholders, teams, and leadership</li> <li>Work with cabling, racking, and other tasks in Physical Data Centers (Some Travel May Be Required)</li> <li>Create user accounts in IAM and other user management resources</li> <li>Updating Production Server Resources and Sizing</li> <li>Support and troubleshooting in medium to complex technical issues</li> <li>Follow the company Code of Ethics and CXone policies and procedures at all times</li> </ul> <h3>Have you got what it takes?</h3> <h4>Required Qualifications &amp; Experience</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years working in a large production infrastructure</li> <li>5+ years in Windows Server Administration in a Production Environment</li> <li>5+ years configuring server hardware and OS</li> <li>Experience managing and hardening Linux servers in production environments (RHEL, Ubuntu, or Amazon Linux)</li> <li>Experience successfully working in fast-paced production environments with rapidly changing priorities and timelines</li> <li>Microsoft and Linux OS Patching</li> <li>Strong Knowledge of Windows Domains, Active Directory and DNS</li> <li>Experience working with Change Management</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience working in a PCI / Cyber Essentials compliant environment</li> <li>AWS EKS and ECS Experience</li> <li>Experience maintaining relational databases</li> <li>Experience working with Chef, Ansible or Puppet</li> <li>Experience working with SAN or NAS</li> <li>Experience working with Okta</li> <li>Experience working with Hardware Replacements/Vendor Work</li> <li>Experience managing Cisco UCS</li> <li>Experience monitoring and maintaining AWS environments.</li> <li>Experience working with PowerShell and other scripting languages</li> </ul> <h3>What's in it for you?</h3> <p>Join an industry-leading, global technology organization where innovation, cloud transformation, and operational excellence are at the heart of everything we do. title: Associate Technical Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></span></p> <p>NICE Public Safety provides a cloud based enterprise product used by public safety and justice agencies. Our customers depend on this product for time sensitive work, so the system has to be available at all times.</p> <p>We are looking for an Associate Technical Support Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team in Pune. This is an early career role for someone with 1 to 3 years of experience who wants to build a strong foundation in cloud monitoring and production support. The main purpose of the role is to watch the health of our product hosted on Microsoft Azure, respond to alerts, carry out first level troubleshooting and escalate issues to senior engineers with clear and complete information.</p> <p>The person will work under the guidance of senior Technical Support Engineers and is expected to learn quickly, follow established SOPs and gradually take on more ownership. We also expect them to be curious about AI tools such as Claude and Copilot and willing to use them in their daily work.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Monitor production systems on Azure using tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana and Kibana.</li> <li>Watch alert queues and dashboards, acknowledge alerts promptly and act on them as per the defined SOPs.</li> <li>Carry out first level troubleshooting by reviewing logs, metrics and recent changes, and document findings clearly.</li> <li>Raise and track incidents in the ticketing tool, escalate to senior engineers or Advanced Support on time and with complete information.</li> <li>Assist senior engineers during major incidents by gathering logs, running health checks and keeping notes.</li> <li>Help reduce false alarms by reporting noisy or misfiring alerts to the senior team.</li> <li>Use AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to help read logs, summaries incidents and draft updates.</li> <li>Write simple scripts to automate routine tasks such as reports and health checks, with guidance from senior engineers.</li> <li>Share clear and timely updates with internal stakeholders during incidents.</li> <li>Follow and help update SOPs, knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.</li> <li>Meet the defined SLAs, KPIs and escalation processes.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></span></p> <p></p> <ul> <li>1 to 3 years of experience in technical support, application support, NOC, production monitoring or cloud operations.</li> <li>Basic hands on exposure to Microsoft Azure and at least one monitoring or logging tool such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana or Kibana.</li> <li>Basic understanding of cloud concepts, web applications and how client server systems work.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Windows or Linux, including reading logs and checking services and processes.</li> <li>Basic scripting ability in PowerShell, Python or Shell, or a strong willingness to learn.</li> <li>Familiarity with a ticketing tool such as ServiceNow or Jira.</li> <li>Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or ChatGPT for day to day technical work.</li> <li>Good written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to explain a technical issue clearly to a senior engineer or a customer.</li> <li>Eager to learn, takes feedback well and follows processes carefully.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field (BE, BTech or BSc).</li> <li>Exposure to KQL queries in Log Analytics.</li> <li>Basic knowledge of REST APIs and how to test them.</li> <li>Awareness of Docker, Kubernetes or CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li>Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or ITIL Foundation certification.</li> <li>Interest in AI tools, prompt writing or building small automations.</li> <li>This role works in rotational shifts aligned to US time zones, including night shifts.</li> <li>The person will be part of a weekend on-call rotation shared across the team.</li> <li>The role is based in our Pune office and works with global teams.</li> <li>Work on a product that public safety and justice agencies rely on every day.</li> <li>Learn from experienced engineers and get hands on with the latest monitoring, automation and AI tools.</li> <li>Clear growth path to Technical Support Engineer and onward to Advanced Support, SRE, Cloud Operations or AI Operations.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.</span></p> <p><strong>Requisition ID:11916</strong><br><strong>Reporting into:</strong> Tech Manager&nbsp;<br><strong>Role Type:</strong> Individual Contributor</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. title: Specialist Software Engineer ( AI Architect , Developement )
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder (SPARK)</h1> <h2>So, what’s the role all about?</h2> <p>NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for the senior technical voice and hands-on builder at its core.</p> <p>As Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, you will set the technical direction for SPARK and build alongside the team. You will advise on the tech stack, choose the patterns and tools we standardise on, and write the code for flagship prototypes yourself. You will also advise business and technology leaders on what is feasible, what is wise, and what to build next.</p> <p>This is a consultative and autonomous role. You are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, making sound technical decisions with minimal supervision, and explaining your reasoning to engineers and executives alike. You will be the senior technical lead for the SPARK AI Architects &amp; Builders.</p> <h2>How will you make an impact?</h2> <p>You will own the technical architecture of SPARK and the quality of what it ships, from the first prototype to the enterprise-grade tool, working hands-on with the Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, the Business Analyst, and NiCE’s platform, security, and architecture teams.</p> <h3>Set Technical Direction</h3> <ul> <li>Recommend and own the SPARK tech stack: models and providers, agent and orchestration frameworks, retrieval and vector storage, integration patterns, and developer tooling</li> <li>Make build-versus-buy and platform-versus-custom decisions, and record them in clear architecture decision records</li> <li>Define reference architectures and reusable patterns so every new idea starts from a paved path instead of a blank page</li> <li>Track the fast-moving AI landscape and bring forward the models, tools, and protocols worth adopting</li> <li>Ensure build allows tools to be migrated easily.</li> <li>Always ensure cost optimization is included into the design.</li> </ul> <h3>Build Hands-On</h3> <ul> <li>Design and build agentic AI solutions, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, memory, multi-agent coordination, and human-in-the-loop controls</li> <li>Build RAG pipelines and integrations with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365, using APIs and MCP</li> <li>Ensure solution design incorporates NiCE guidelines on Ethics, Risk, compliance</li> <li>Review data and infrastructure readiness of the solutions</li> <li>Write clean, tested, documented code that others can pick up and extend</li> <li>Turn ideas into working prototypes quickly, and into demonstrable value for the business teams who proposed them</li> </ul> <h3>Take Prototypes to Enterprise Grade</h3> <ul> <li>Define what enterprise-grade means for SPARK: security, access control, privacy, reliability, scalability, observability, and cost</li> <li>Harden prototypes for global rollout, including CI/CD, automated tests, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, and rollback</li> <li>Establish LLM evaluation practices: test sets, regression tests, hallucination checks, and quality dashboards</li> <li>Work with Security, Legal, and Architecture teams to embed responsible AI and data protection requirements into every design</li> </ul> <h3>Advise and Lead</h3> <ul> <li>Act as trusted technical adviser to business teams, the Project Manager, and senior leaders on feasibility, trade-offs, effort, and risk</li> <li>Review designs and code, mentor the Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, and raise the engineering bar across the team</li> <li>Work with minimal supervision, flag risks early, and make good decisions when requirements are still moving</li> <li>Collaborate with NiCE’s internal/ external AI platform and architecture teams so SPARK solutions fit the wider enterprise AI strategy</li> </ul> <h2>Have you got what it takes?</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred), or equivalent experience</li> <li>10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years designing and delivering LLM-powered or agentic AI systems in production</li> <li>Expert, hands-on skills in Python and/or TypeScript; you are still a developer who writes code every week</li> <li>Deep experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent), tool-integration protocols such as MCP, and RAG architectures with vector databases</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of LLM providers and APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, and open-source models), including prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation</li> <li>Experience with at least one major cloud AI ecosystem (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and with REST API, event-driven, and microservice design</li> <li>Strong grasp of security, privacy, and responsible AI practices for enterprise systems</li> <li>Proven ability to work independently, advise stakeholders, and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to executives and non-technical colleagues</li> <li>Fluency in English</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in an AI centre of excellence, innovation lab, or internal incubator</li> <li>Experience with Cognigy, NiCE CXone, or other CCaaS and conversational AI platforms, including voice AI</li> <li>Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Atlassian, and Microsoft 365</li> <li>Experience with LLMOps: evaluation frameworks, observability (OpenTelemetry), prompt registries, and cost governance</li> <li>Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-source models</li> <li>Experience with workflow applications such as N8N or similar</li> <li>Have developed market ready software applications</li> <li>Fluency in foreign language; German would be a plus, for close collaboration with Forward Deployment Cognigy team in Germany.</li> </ul> <h2>What’s in it for you?</h2> <p>SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.</p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!</p> <h2>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</h2> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.</p> <p><strong>Requisition ID: </strong>11874</p> <p><strong>Reporting into: </strong>VP , Business Operations , Sales Ops</p> <p><strong>Role Type</strong> : Individual Contributor</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><h2>So, what’s the role all about?</h2> <p>NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for builders who understand the business as well as the code.</p> <p>As Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, you will design and build the AI solutions that SPARK brings to life. You combine real business knowledge with solid software engineering: you understand how sales, service, support, and operations teams actually work, and you know how to take an idea through the full software development lifecycle to a solution people use every day.</p> <p>You will work as part of a small team of senior builders, led by the Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, with significant ownership of the solutions you deliver. You will partner closely with the Business Analyst and the Project Manager.</p> <h2>How will you make an impact?</h2> <p>You will design and build the AI solutions at the heart of SPARK, owning them from the first prototype through hardening and handover, working with the Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, the Business Analyst, and the Project Manager.</p> <h3>Design Solutions that Fit the Business</h3> <ul> <li>Work with the Business Analyst and business teams to understand the process, the users, and the outcome, and shape a solution design that fits how people actually work</li> <li>Translate use cases into solution architectures covering agents, retrieval, integrations, data flows, and user experience</li> <li>Choose the right approach for each problem, whether that is an AI agent, a workflow automation, a prompt-based assistant, or a conventional software fix</li> <li>Estimate effort and flag technical risks early to the Project Manager</li> </ul> <h3>Build and Ship</h3> solutions to enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Snowflake, Power BI, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365</li> <li>Apply prompt engineering and context design that deliver reliable results, and iterate on user feedback</li> <li>Write clean, tested, documented code and keep it in well-organised shared repositories</li> <li>Optimize solution costs</li> </ul> <h3>Engineer for Quality and Scale</h3> <ul> <li>Apply the full SDLC to every solution (design, build, test, release, and support), using Git workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Build automated evaluations and regression tests so quality is measured, not assumed</li> <li>Add logging, monitoring, and cost tracking so solutions can be run and supported in production</li> <li>Follow the security, privacy, and responsible AI standards set with the Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder and NiCE’s security teams</li> <li>Ensue audit trails are included and follow the discussed solutions on agreed guardrails measure.</li> </ul> <h3>Hand Over and Improve</h3> <ul> <li>Prepare documentation, runbooks, and demos for the Support Helpdesk, the Change Management &amp; Evangelist, and the business teams who will use each solution</li> <li>Use feedback and recurring support issues to fix, improve, and extend solutions after launch</li> <li>Share patterns and reusable components that make the next build faster</li> </ul> <h2>Have you got what it takes?</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>6-8 years of software development experience across the full SDLC, building enterprise-grade, scalable software</li> <li>2+ years of hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, such as RAG pipelines, agents, tool use, or prompt-engineered assistants</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, with strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and async or event-driven design</li> <li>Solid business knowledge: experience working closely with functions such as sales, customer service, operations, or finance, and the ability to turn their needs into working software</li> <li>Experience with at least one agent or orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent) and with vector databases or search</li> <li>Practical experience with a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)</li> <li>Solid Git workflow, code review, testing, and CI/CD practices</li> <li>Ability to work with autonomy in a small, fast-moving team with evolving requirements</li> <li>Fluency in English</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience implementing MCP servers or clients, and integrating with enterprise systems</li> <li>Familiarity with the Anthropic Claude API and tool-use patterns</li> <li>Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments, with exposure to Cognigy or NiCE CXone</li> <li>Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and observability tooling</li> <li>Experience with low-code or agent-building platforms such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio</li> <li>Experience in workflow applications such as N8N or similar</li> </ul> <h2>What’s in it for you?</h2> <p>SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.</p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!</p> <h2>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</h2> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. AI.</li> <li>Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p>You will be responsible for:</p> <ul> <li>Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs.</li> <li>Leading technical decisions on architectural direction use of AI in both build-time and run-time.</li> <li>Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.</li> <li>Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.</li> <li>Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.</li> Studio/Visual Studio Code.</li> <li>Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.</li> <li>Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.</li> <li>Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.</li> <li>Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.</li> <li>Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.</li> <li>Good knowledge of SOLID principles.</li> <li>Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.</li> Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided.</li> <li>Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it.</li> <li>Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain.</li> <li>Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Security best practice (OWASP top ten)</li> <li>Azure SQL Server</li> <li>DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub</li> <li>Windows services</li> <li>Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets).</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we do not require</strong></p> <p>We do not require you to be an AI expert. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the AI Architects &amp; Builders, and the Change Management &amp; Evangelist.</p> <h2>How will you make an impact?</h2> <p>You will own the front end of the incubation pipeline, from the first conversation about an idea through to accepted, measurable outcomes, working hands-on with business teams, architects, and delivery colleagues across regions.</p> <h3>Discover and Shape Ideas</h3> <ul> <li>Run discovery sessions, interviews, and workshops with business teams to understand pain points, current processes, and the outcome they want</li> <li>Turn ideas into clear use case briefs covering the problem statement, users, expected value, data needs, risks, and success measures</li> <li>Assess and rank ideas against business value, feasibility, data readiness, effort, and risk, and give the team a clear recommendation on what to build next</li> <li>Build lightweight business cases, including estimated time saved, quality gains, and cost or revenue impact for presentation to Management and AI steering committee</li> </ul> <h3>Define What Gets Built</h3> <ul> <li>Map as-is and to-be processes, and identify where an AI agent, an automation, or a human-in-the-loop step fits best</li> <li>Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that architects and builders can build from without guesswork</li> <li>Specify expected AI behaviour: what the solution should do, what it should never do, when it hands over to a person, and how answers will be checked for quality</li> <li>Prepare test scenarios and evaluation datasets with the builders to measure accuracy, reliability, and usefulness before launch</li> <li>Update initiative register</li> </ul> <h3>Prototype and Validate</h3> <ul> <li>Use SQL, Python, or low-code tools to analyse process data, test assumptions, and build simple prototypes that prove an idea before engineering effort is committed</li> <li>Review APIs and system documentation to confirm integration feasibility with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365</li> <li>Gather early user feedback on prototypes and turn it into prioritised backlog items</li> </ul> <h3>Support Delivery and Adoption</h3> <ul> <li>Own and groom the product backlog, and take part in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives</li> <li>Plan and run user acceptance testing with business users, and manage defects and feedback through to closure</li> <li>Partner with the Change Management &amp; Evangelist and the Support Helpdesk to turn user questions and feedback into clear improvements</li> </ul> <h3>Measure and Share Value</h3> <ul> <li>Capture baseline metrics before launch and track results afterwards, so every solution can show real impact</li> <li>Understand the Software Development Lifecylse to review adoption, continuous business iteration and value realization.</li> <li>Maintain the use case library, requirement templates, and playbooks that make the next idea faster to shape</li> </ul> <h2>Have you got what it takes?</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>5-8 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst in a software, technology, or digital transformation environment</li> <li>A programming background: hands-on experience writing code in at least one language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#, plus working knowledge of SQL and REST APIs</li> <li>Proven skill in requirements engineering: process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability from need to delivered outcome</li> <li>Experience facilitating workshops and aligning senior business stakeholders with technical teams</li> <li>Experience working in Agile teams, with tools such as Jira and Confluence</li> <li>Working understanding of how large language models, RAG, and AI agents work and what they can and cannot do reliably, with hands-on use of AI assistants in your own work</li> <li>Some finance background or knowledge will be a plus</li> <li>Strong analytical, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical ideas in plain business language</li> <li>Fluency in English</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience on AI, GenAI, or automation projects, from use case definition through to production</li> <li>Experience with low-code or agent-building tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio or similar</li> <li>Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments</li> <li>Familiarity with evaluating LLM output quality, including test set design and acceptance thresholds</li> <li>Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA</li> <li>Experience working across regions and time zones, with teams in International and the Americas</li> </ul> <h2>What’s in it for you?</h2> <p>SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.</p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs.</li> <li>Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach.</li> <li>Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time.</li> <li>Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.</li> <li>Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.</li> <li>Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.</li> <li>Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code.</li> <li>Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.</li> <li>Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.</li> <li>Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.</li> <li>Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.</li> <li>Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.</li> <li>Good knowledge of SOLID principles.</li> <li>Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.</li> <li>Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. You work proactively and independently: you research topics yourself, align with stakeholders, and draw on internal and external sources for constant inspiration. You then produce the content yourself, from video and demos to presentations and webinars.</p> <p>The role sits within Product Marketing and works closely with Product, Engineering, NiCE Labs and Marketing. A large part of it is agentic building: creating AI agents, demos and prototypes with coding agents such as Claude Code, through the Cognigy plugin and with other vibe coding tools. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to be deeply hands-on and able to build things that work. The AI market moves faster than any market before it, and this role is built for that speed.</p> <p>You bring an AI-first mindset and real technical depth. You can explain sophisticated technology in a simple, compelling way, and you use AI tools throughout your own workflow to raise both speed and quality.</p> <p>Success in this role means a steady stream of differentiated content that builds NiCE Cognigy's credibility in agentic AI, grows our audience, and supports launches and revenue teams with assets they want to use. All of it is aligned with our overall product marketing strategy and company goals.</p> <p><span title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><h1>Senior Technical Account Manager</h1> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Location: Remote, USA</strong></p> <h3>So, what’s the role all about?</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As a <strong>Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM)</strong> at NiCE, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and advocate for some of our most complex CXone customers. You will begin engaging with customers prior to go-live and maintain ownership of the relationship throughout their journey, helping ensure they successfully adopt, optimize, and realize value from their CXone solutions.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will combine strategic account management with advanced technical problem-solving, working closely with customers to understand their contact center environments, resolve complex challenges, prevent escalations, and identify opportunities to improve their overall experience. Internally, you will partner across Technical Support, Professional Services, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and other teams to drive customer outcomes.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As a senior member of the TAM organization, you will also serve as a technical and customer-management leader, mentoring other TAMs, sharing best practices, and helping improve processes across the organization.</p> <h3>How will you make an impact?</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned strategic and complex customer accounts.</li> <li>Build strong customer relationships through regular engagement focused on business objectives, technical environments, open issues, product usage, and opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Lead customers through go-live preparation and help establish confidence and success as they transition into production.</li> <li>Take ownership of complex technical issues and customer escalations, coordinating resources across Technical Support, Professional Services, Product Management, Engineering, and other teams through resolution.</li> <li>Perform advanced troubleshooting and technical triage while helping customers navigate complex contact center and CXone environments.</li> <li>Ensure customer issues, cases, and requests progress appropriately and remain within established SLA and OLA expectations.</li> <li>Maintain a deep understanding of each customer's technical environment and business objectives to proactively identify needs, risks, and opportunities.</li> <li>Drive customer satisfaction, retention, adoption, and referenceability across assigned accounts.</li> <li>Develop and deliver customized customer presentations demonstrating product usage, realized value, achievements, opportunities, and recommended next steps.</li> <li>Provide technical and product training that enables customers to maximize the value of their NiCE CXone investment.</li> <li>Communicate confidently and professionally with technical, business, and executive stakeholders, including during high-pressure or escalated situations.</li> <li>Identify potential escalations early and coordinate the appropriate internal resources to prevent or resolve them.</li> <li>Develop business cases that clearly define customer challenges, business impact, proposed solutions, and expected outcomes.</li> <li>Maintain accurate and timely customer, account, activity, and case information within CRM systems.</li> <li>Capture and share technical knowledge, best practices, and repeatable solutions through knowledge-base content and internal training.</li> <li>Mentor and coach TAMs and other team members in technical troubleshooting, customer management, escalation handling, and best practices.</li> <li>Serve as a subject matter expert across multiple technical areas and help develop technical capabilities across the broader TAM organization.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering teams to communicate customer feedback, product issues, and enhancement opportunities.</li> <li>Identify and lead projects and initiatives that improve processes, customer experience, operational efficiency, and overall team performance.</li> <li>Serve as a resource for struggling or escalated accounts and help develop strategies that return those customers to successful outcomes.</li> <li>Work primarily during customers' core business hours, with occasional extended or after-hours support as customer needs require.</li> <li>Travel up to 25% for customer meetings, site visits, and company events.</li> </ul> <h3>Have you got what it takes?</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.</li> <li>10+ years of experience in technical services, software, telecommunications, customer service, contact center technology, and/or service delivery.</li> <li>Demonstrated success managing complex customer relationships in technical environments.</li> <li>Strong technical problem-solving, analytical, triage, and advanced troubleshooting skills.</li> <li>Working technical knowledge of contact center software, architecture, design, and functionality.</li> <li>Experience resolving complex and high-impact technical and customer issues.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.</li> <li>Strong customer-service orientation and the ability to establish trusted-advisor relationships.</li> <li>Ability to communicate calmly, confidently, and professionally during escalations and other high-pressure customer situations.</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with technical and business teams to drive issues through resolution.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer needs in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound professional judgment, and drive projects through completion.</li> <li>Experience communicating technical and functional concepts while maintaining strong business relationships.</li> <li>Strong understanding of contact center operations, KPIs, and industry best practices.</li> <li>Ability to train, mentor, present, and share technical knowledge effectively with customers and colleagues.</li> <li>Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and experience maintaining customer information within CRM systems.</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Experience with NiCE CXone or similar cloud contact center/CCaaS platforms.</li> <li>Advanced knowledge of telecommunications, contact center, and IP telephony technologies.</li> <li>TCP/IP networking knowledge and experience with internet and network fundamentals.</li> <li>Experience with VoIP technologies and SIP signaling.</li> <li>Understanding of network topology and telecommunications architecture, including PBX and carrier environments.</li> <li>Knowledge of telecom circuits and associated technologies.</li> <li>Experience with databases, SQL concepts, and scripting.</li> <li>Understanding of software engineering, integrations, programming concepts, and/or database technologies.</li> <li>Experience serving as a technical subject matter expert, mentor, trainer, or escalation resource.</li> <li>Experience presenting or delivering technical training to large audiences.</li> <li>A highly analytical, inquisitive, collaborative, service-oriented mindset with an interest in emerging technologies.</li> </ul> <h3>What’s in it for you?</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting global company where teams work collaboratively to build innovative solutions and deliver exceptional experiences for our customers. You'll have the opportunity to work with leading contact center technology, partner with strategic customers, solve complex business and technical challenges, and influence how we continue improving our products and customer experience.</p> <h3>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX model, which enables maximum flexibility: two days working from the office and three days of remote work each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation and new ideas.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><em>For this remote position, work arrangements will be aligned with the requirements of the role and assigned customers.</em></p> <h3>About NiCE</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">NiCE is a global leader in AI-powered customer experience solutions, helping organizations of all sizes deliver extraordinary customer experiences, improve operational efficiency, and drive better business outcomes.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Known for innovation and a people-first culture, NiCE empowers organizations around the world through industry-leading technology while providing employees opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.</p> <p>NiCE is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to legally protected characteristics.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>Any issue with our software that impairs the operation of a customer’s contact centre has significant financial ramifications for them. Our ability to restore service, improve their understanding, and resolve chronic issues will greatly increase the value they receive from our solutions and will reduce financial risk when they experience problems.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrate deep subject matter expertise in our core technologies, as well as at least one other technology specialty, and develop expertise in a second area of specialty.</li> <li>Provide advanced technical support to customers via phone, online, chat, and email and use tools and advanced expertise to pull and effectively analyse logs, traces, packet captures, etc. to determine root cause of issues.</li> <li>Demonstrate professional, assertive, articulate, and friendly verbal and written communication in all aspects of your work. Take full ownership of all communication needs related to the management of troubleshooting efforts internally and externally, building confidence across all customers and stakeholders that we are progressing properly towards resolution.</li> <li>Effectively mentor colleagues on their communication, troubleshooting, process, product knowledge and case work.</li> <li>Encourage productive debate and discussion with colleagues to more thoroughly analyse and resolve problems.</li> <li>Be influential in improving procedures and processes that improve our efficiency and effectiveness.</li> <li>Ensure that each case that you own is progressing according to the response and resolution targets as specified in our Service Level Agreements (SLA). Assist colleagues in accelerating their cases toward timely resolution.</li> <li>Provide root cause correction, not just symptom relief. Ensure that all facets of the problem are evaluated to eliminate the recurrence of the issue. Exemplify tenacity in resolving core issues that fully resolve problems and assist peers in doing the same.</li> <li>Proactively manage personally assigned and cases from the queue based upon severity and priority of each issue and your skills and ability to resolve.</li> <li>Open and monitor incidents created with 3rd party providers. Work with other internal stakeholders to improve our interactions and success in handling these incidents.</li> <li>Obtain and maintain certification as a Knowledge-Cantered Service (KCS) Publisher, create useful knowledge content, and update existing knowledgebase articles using KCS methodology. Provide coaching to others on KCS best practices.</li> <li>Identify, document, and report issues with software, design, reliability, and maintenance issues to the proper teams, ensuring that they are aware of and are addressing customer expectations. Gather, validate, and document all pertinent details related to an issue believed to be a bug to enable the receiving R&amp;D resource to duplicate the issue easily and rapidly. Work with R&amp;D as needed during isolation, correction, and implementation of any delivered resolution.</li> <li>Develop and maintain consistent and exemplary performance on all key performance indicators, modelling a higher-level achievement for level 1 Technical Support Engineers as well as your peers at the same job level.</li> <li>Properly de-escalate customers through expert communication and resource engagement, ensuring that all customers that you influence are receiving excellent service. Expected to handle more complex and escalated cases.</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep understanding of networking technologies and how they are utilized by our products, platform, and customers. Expert at reading and analying network and other technical diagrams to aid in problem diagnosis and resolution, and often provide mentoring to colleagues to improve their technical abilities.</li> <li>Provide training to colleagues in real time as you perform your work and assist them in being successful in their roles. Develop training materials, best practice documentation, and other resources that will help others, including customers, to be more successful with our products.</li> <li>While a consistent work schedule is a norm, the ability to work a flexible schedule and provide on-call services is needed from time to time.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years’ work experience in a technical customer service role, preferably in a technical support capacity.</li> <li>Minimum of three years of experience working with and advanced knowledge of technologies such as SaaS, telecommunications, contact centre software, networking technologies such as TCP/IP, HTTP, SFTP, scripting, load balancers, proxies, firewalls, and Relational Databases (MSSQL, Oracle, MySQL).</li> <li>Excellent technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills for diverse and complex issues in high-pressure, complex, SaaS multi-platform/system/vendor environments.</li> <li>Excellent professional, written and verbal communications skills with the ability to capture all details in written form during conversations. Communication is assertive, articulate, and friendly while building confidence across all stakeholders you work with.</li> <li>Time management skills that allow you to work in a highly influential manner in an interrupt-driven environment. Ability to multi-task and maintain professional composure during stressful situations, prioritizing your activities appropriately.</li> <li>Superior analytical and problem-solving skills while managing diverse and complex issues in high-pressure, complex, multi-platform/system/vendor environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to utilize, create and update knowledgebase resources in the course of your work.</li> <li>Proven ability to drive escalated customer problems to resolution utilizing appropriate internal and external resources.</li> <li>Ability to communicate effectively across all company teams such as Product Management, Research and Development, Quality Assurance, Professional Services, and Executive/Senior Management teams to resolve technical issues.</li> <li>Industry experience including understanding of the contact centre business, as well as general market and business trends.</li> <li>Understanding of networking technologies and telecommunications architecture (PBX, Carriers, VoIP).</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work independently as part of a larger team.</li> <li>Ability to excel in a fast-paced, agile environment with assertiveness, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Ability to adapt quickly to change, think on your feet, communicate positively and work proactively.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to troubleshoot VoIP, telephony/telecom technologies, DS3, Ethernet, OC-X, 1+ and toll-free services.</li> <li>Experience in a technical support role in a software or telecommunications environment.</li> <li>Workforce Management software and/or outbound dialler experience.</li> <li>Web Services and API knowledge and understanding of conceptual use.</li> <li>Competent in database and SQL concepts.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Education Requirement:</strong></p> <p>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business Information description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what's the role all about?</strong></p> <p>NiCE Cognigy is looking for a Manager, PreSales Engineering, AI to lead our Sales Engineering team across three of our fastest-growing continental European markets: Benelux, France, and Nordics.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, frontline manager role. You'll stay close to the business - personally engaging in strategic deal support alongside your team - while carrying direct responsibility for market penetration, lead generation, and building thought leadership as we scale in these regions.</p> <p>You'll lead a team of 5-6 Sales Engineers who provide technical demos, support discovery calls, answer technical RFPs, and actively support events across Benelux, France, and Nordics, and you'll report to our Senior Director, PreSales Engineering, AI.</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a hands-on, frontline manager - staying close to the business and personally engaging in strategic deal support alongside your team, rather than managing from a distance.</li> <li>Own market penetration for Benelux, France, and Nordics, turning your team's efforts into sustained new-business growth across these emerging regions.</li> <li>Drive lead generation initiatives that build qualified pipeline in these markets, working closely with marketing and regional sales.</li> <li>Build and scale thought leadership for the team across Benelux, France, and Nordics, positioning Cognigy as a trusted authority as these regions grow.</li> <li>Lead the Sales Engineering team, making sure demo pitches and other activities are prioritized correctly.</li> <li>Take the presales lead on RFPs, making sure they're delivered on time together with the Bid Manager in region.</li> <li>Approach opportunities holistically - bridging technical capabilities with solution requirements and business impact, including customer experience and ROI.</li> <li>Support customer success with upsell opportunities by spotting strategic openings.</li> <li>Engage with a broad range of customer and partner stakeholders, from hands-on technical contacts to VP level, identifying champions and building relationships.</li> <li>Delegate work and prioritize team activities with full autonomy.</li> <li>Liaise with regional sales and customer success leaders.</li> <li>Stay on top of the competitive landscape, comparing our software with other conversational AI products on the market.</li> <li>Facilitate internal training so the team stays sharp and up to date.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in enterprise software, ideally with contact center or automation technologies - whether at a software company or building custom solutions.</li> <li>Proven “team lead” or manager experience: leading a team, running regular 1:1s, and genuinely understanding what your people need.</li> <li>The ability to coach individuals and build a high-performing team, backed by a solid foundational understanding of technology and AI.</li> <li>A drive to stay current and share knowledge across the team in a fast-changing environment.</li> <li>Comfort dealing with pressure - tight presentation deadlines, unexpected team gaps, and everything in between.</li> <li>Deep understanding of Conversational AI technologies, including GenAI, LLMs, speech-to-text (STT), and text-to-speech (TTS) solutions.</li> <li>Familiarity with agentic AI concepts such as RAG, MCP and A2A communication.</li> <li>Strong selling skills - qualifying opportunities, building rapport, and demonstrating NiCE Cognigy's value with confidence.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and lead a team successfully, including full people-management responsibilities.</li> <li>A curious, adaptable mindset - you stay on top of the latest trends in conversational AI and love learning new things.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s in it for you?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:6,&quot;335551620&quot;:6,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:240,&quot;335572083&quot;:0,&quot;335572084&quot;:0,&quot;335572085&quot;:4278190080,&quot;469789810&quot;:&quot;nil&quot;}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams - title: Head of Partners, APAC
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what's the role all about?</strong></p> <p>This is a senior leadership role for a commercially sharp, relationship-first partnerships executive who is ready to own APAC partner growth for NiCE. You will report directly into the VP Partner Sales, International, and lead a team of 8-10 partner managers across a region spanning India, Middle East, ANZ, Japan and South-East Asia. &nbsp;<br><br>APAC is at an inflection point for NiCE. Partner-led revenue is growing quickly, and this role exists to accelerate that momentum by building deeper strategic relationships, raising the execution quality of the team, and aligning the partner ecosystem to the AI-first CX transformation story that NiCE and Cognigy represent together. &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p><strong>Partner strategy and ecosystem development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute the APAC partner strategy, aligned to NiCE's international commercial objectives and partner-led revenue targets.</li> <li>Build and grow a high-performing partner ecosystem across GSIs, hyperscalers, regional system integrators, BPOs, and value-added resellers in India, Middle East, ANZ, Japan, and South-East Asia.</li> <li>Establish and deepen executive-level relationships with partner leadership across the region, leveraging your existing APAC network from day one.</li> <li>Work with hyperscaler partners AWS and Microsoft to develop co-sell, marketplace, and joint go-to-market motions that accelerate pipeline and deal velocity.</li> <li>Identify, qualify, and onboard new strategic partners where gaps exist in current ecosystem coverage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Revenue and pipeline ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline to meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets across APAC.</li> <li>Maintain full pipeline visibility through disciplined use of Salesforce and NiCE's partner operating cadence QBRs, MBRs, and weekly deal reviews.</li> <li>Build joint business plans with Tier 1 and Platinum partners, including clear revenue commitments, enablement milestones, and executive alignment.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with APAC sales leadership, marketing, and pre-sales to ensure partner opportunities convert and partners are fully equipped to close.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team leadership and performance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 8-10 Partner Managers across APAC, setting clear performance standards and a high-execution culture.</li> <li>Build a team environment anchored on accountability, coaching, and continuous enablement with a focus on producing partner managers who can operate independently in market.</li> <li>Hire, onboard, and retain talent in line with APAC headcount plans as the function scales.</li> <li>Bring the energy and operating discipline to run a high-performing regional function, with a consistent rhythm of field engagement, pipeline reviews, and executive stakeholder management.</li> And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>The team</strong></p> <p>NiCE&nbsp;Labs (nice.com/nice-labs) is where&nbsp;NiCE&nbsp;explores&nbsp;what's&nbsp;next in AI for customer experience. This role&nbsp;is on&nbsp;AI Innovation, the Labs pillar that builds and&nbsp;validates&nbsp;new AI capabilities through prototypes, so the company can make better product decisions, faster.<span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We're&nbsp;a deliberately small, senior team of builders inside&nbsp;NiCE&nbsp;Cognigy, the AI agent platform. We operate in fast iteration cycles: spot an emerging capability, build a working prototype, validate it against real metrics (quality, latency, cost, user impact), and then&nbsp;decide:&nbsp;kill it, iterate, publish it, or hand it off to a product team. Some of our work is public, like the open-sourced&nbsp;Cognigy&nbsp;Platform MCP server; most of it shapes the product roadmap from the inside.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We hire&nbsp;for&nbsp;product mindset and builder mentality. Everyone on the team takes ideas from zero to working software, shows them to real users, and argues from evidence.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>You'll&nbsp;work at the intersection of frontier AI capabilities and a real enterprise product. The field moves faster than any roadmap can track. Your job is to close that gap: turn new models, protocols, and agent patterns into working systems, prove what matters in realistic scenarios, and produce the insights and reference implementations that let product and engineering teams move with confidence.<span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You'll&nbsp;need to be comfortable with ambiguity, at home where best practices&nbsp;don't&nbsp;exist yet, and quick to move on when the results point elsewhere.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong><strong> </strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build agentic systems and full-stack prototypes end-to-end, shipping a first version in days and learning from real use</li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Track the frontier (new models, agent patterns, protocols like MCP) and turn the promising ones into working prototypes rather than slideware</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Design experiments that show whether a concept holds up, measured in quality, latency, cost, and user impact</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Work directly with internal users, product managers, and customers to validate concepts early and iterate quickly</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:100}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Turn validated prototypes into reference implementations and write-ups that product teams can build on, then hand off cleanly and move to the next bet</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Give product and platform teams concrete feedback on where AI capabilities shine and where they fall short</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Move between initiatives as priorities shift. What you learn on one bet compounds into the next</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Have 4+ years building full-stack software, including things you started from nothing. We weigh what you've shipped more than years on a CV<span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:100}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Have shipped LLM-powered systems to&nbsp;production:features real users depended on, not demos or notebooks</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:100}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Understand AI agents below the framework level: message arrays, tool calling, context management, prompt caching. You could build an agent loop from scratch and explain why it works</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as your default way of working, and it makes you measurably faster, not just busier</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Are&nbsp;full-stackin practice: comfortable taking a prototype from API to demo UI on your own (our stack centers on TypeScript/Node.js and React)</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:100}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Do your best work when the ground is still moving. through implementation.</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact? </strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Business Planning and Performance Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead budgeting, <li>Establish reporting and analytical frameworks that enable leaders to make timely, informed decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Commercial and Deal improvements that reduce cycle time, risk, and manual effort.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Systems, Data, and Reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain and enhance sales
