operations tools.</li> <li>Define business requirements and partner with technical teams on system enhancements, automation, testing, and implementation.</li> <li>Develop and improve tools used for quoting, forecasting, product and service costing, margin analysis, and revenue and expense management.</li> <li>Promote strong data quality, process compliance, and consistent use of sales systems across the organization.</li> <li>Build scalable reporting solutions that reduce manual work and provide stakeholders with accessible, actionable information.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Process Improvement and Cross-Functional Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead complex, cross-functional sales operations initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption.</li> <li>Assess current processes, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that improve accuracy, speed, and stakeholder experience.</li> <li>Establish clear process documentation, governance, controls, and performance measures.</li> <li>Partner with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Professional Services, and Support teams to expertise, and informal mentorship to colleagues while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.</li> <li>Support change-management and enablement activities associated with new systems, processes, policies, and operating models.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Have you got what it takes? </strong></li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, role.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience supporting a complex, global, or enterprise sales organization.</li> <li>Expert Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of CoPilot and Claude is a actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience building management reports, dashboards, and financial or operational models.</li> <li>Strong experience description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong>We are looking for a&nbsp;<strong>Senior&nbsp;&nbsp;software engineer&nbsp;</strong>who is passionate about solving infrastructure challenges through software engineering and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that streamline cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes.</p> <p>You will build programmatic infrastructure solutions using&nbsp;<strong>Python</strong>,&nbsp;<strong>Jinja2</strong>, and&nbsp;<strong>Terraform</strong>, generating and managing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) at scale. You will also leverage&nbsp;<strong>Puppet</strong>&nbsp;for configuration management and develop&nbsp;<strong>PowerShell-based automation</strong>&nbsp;to support and optimize Windows environments.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, coding-focused position. The ideal candidate is a software-minded engineer who writes clean, maintainable, and testable code every day—not just ad hoc scripts. You should be comfortable designing reusable automation components, applying software development best practices, and driving operational excellence through automation across complex cloud and hybrid environments.</p> <p><strong>How Will You Make an Impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive infrastructure standardization and operational excellence by designing and developing scalable automation Windows platforms by creating robust PowerShell automation solutions for server management, Active Directory administration, and hybrid cloud integrations.</li> <li>Simplify complex infrastructure workflows by developing internal automation tools, command-line utilities, and APIs that empower engineering teams to self-service common operational tasks.</li> <li>Enhance the speed and safety of infrastructure delivery by integrating automation frameworks with CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated validation, testing, and deployment of infrastructure changes.</li> <li>Improve software quality platform, and application teams to identify manual processes, eliminate operational toil, and drive automation-first solutions across the organization.</li> <li>Enable long-term scalability and maintainability by creating clear documentation, standards, and runbooks for automation frameworks and infrastructure templates.</li> <li>Contribute to a strong engineering culture by participating in code reviews, sharing best practices, and continuously improving the quality, security, and maintainability of automation solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it title: Senior Trust Security Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><h4><strong>So what's the role all about?</strong></h4> <p>The Senior Trust Analyst — UK Sovereign sits at the intersection of security, sales, and customer success, serving as the primary trust and security point of contact for our UK Sovereign customers. This role owns the response to customer security inquiries and questionnaires, supports contract reviews on security and privacy terms, and acts as a trusted advisor on the security posture of our UK Sovereign environments.</p> <p>In addition to traditional Trust Analyst responsibilities, this role serves as the dedicated liaison between UK Sovereign technical security teams and customers, ensuring transparency, trust, and proactive communication. The Senior Trust Analyst will track and report vulnerability remediation activities in a structured Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&amp;M) format, deliver regular security status updates, and translate complex technical information into clear, customer-ready communications.</p> <p>This is a senior, customer-facing position critical to building and sustaining trust with UK government and regulated sector customers, accelerating deal cycles, and reinforcing the integrity of our UK Sovereign security program.</p> <h4>How will you make an impact?</h4> <h2>Customer Trust &amp; Security Engagement</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor: </strong>Serve as the primary point of contact for UK Sovereign customers on all matters related to security posture, vulnerabilities, remediation activities, and trust documentation.</li> <li><strong>Security Questionnaires: </strong>Support end-to-end responses to customer and prospect security questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, VSA, MoD/UK government questionnaires, and bespoke enterprise formats), ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent answers tailored to UK Sovereign context.</li> <li><strong>Responder: </strong>Help respond to inbound customer security inquiries via email and ticketing, translating technical controls into clear business language for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Trust Portal &amp; Documentation: </strong>Maintain the public trust center and UK Sovereign customer-facing documentation, ensuring security whitepapers, certifications, and standard responses remain current and reusable.</li> </ul> <h2>Security Posture &amp; Vulnerability Reporting</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Security Posture Assessment: </strong>Collaborate closely with UK Sovereign technical and engineering teams to understand and assess the current security posture of UK Sovereign environments.</li> <li><strong>POA&amp;M Reporting: </strong>help support vulnerability remediation status in a structured Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&amp;M) format, documenting identified vulnerabilities, planned remediation steps, responsible parties, target completion dates, and progress against agreed timelines.</li> <li><strong>Monthly Customer Reporting: </strong>help prepare and<strong> </strong>deliver monthly security status updates to UK Sovereign customers, including progress on scheduled remediation items and key security metrics.</li> <li><strong>Remediation Oversight: </strong>Monitor and track remediation activities across engineering and security teams, ensuring alignment with agreed timelines and compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <h2>Audit</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Audit Interpretation: </strong>Read and interpret third-party audit reports (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, penetration test summaries) and represent findings to customers in questionnaires and security responses.</li> </ul> <h2>Communication &amp; Stakeholder Management</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Information Translation: </strong>Gather detailed technical information from engineering and security teams, then convert and filter it into clear, concise, and structured updates accessible to both technical experts and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Customer Meetings: </strong>participate in security review meetings, capture feedback and action items, and ensure timely follow-up and resolution by technical teams.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Coordination: </strong>Coordinate input from internal teams to validate questionnaire answers and resolve gaps between stated controls and operational reality.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Citizenship &amp; Clearance: </strong>UK citizenship and ability to pass and maintain SC clearance.</li> <li><strong>Experience: </strong>5+ years in a security, GRC, trust, or technical customer-facing role, with direct ownership of security questionnaires, customer inquiries, and security reporting.</li> <li><strong>Questionnaire Expertise: </strong>Hands-on experience responding to SIG, CAIQ, VSA, and bespoke enterprise/government security questionnaires.</li> <li><strong>Compliance Knowledge: </strong>Working knowledge of Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and at least one of PCI DSS, GDPR/UK GDPR, HIPAA, or FedRAMP.</li> <li><strong>Technical Expertise: </strong>Strong technical understanding of security principles, architecture, and vulnerability management, including access control, encryption, incident response, network security, and secure SDLC.</li> <li><strong>Cloud &amp; SaaS: </strong>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security models.</li> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to translate complex technical controls for non-technical audiences (procurement, legal, executives, government stakeholders).</li> <li><strong>Customer Relations: </strong>Proven experience in customer-facing roles within security or technology sectors, ideally including regulated or government customers.</li> <li><strong>Organisational Skills: </strong>Demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume queue, set priorities, and drive multi-stakeholder responses to deadline.</li> <li><strong>Education: </strong>Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li><strong>Discretion: </strong>Proven ability to handle confidential customer and company information with integrity and discretion.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Professional cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSK, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, Security+).</li> <li>Experience working with UK Sovereign, MoD, or UK government environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with POA&amp;M processes and structured vulnerability remediation reporting.</li> <li>Experience with trust portal platforms (ServiceNow, Whistic, Vanta Trust, Drata Trust).</li> <li>Familiarity with AI/ML security and emerging frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001).</li> <li>Previous leadership or line management experience.</li> <li>Integrity and discretion when handling sensitive customer and government information.</li> <li>Resilience and adaptability title: Team Lead, Technical Support
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>Team Lead, Technical Support.</strong></p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>Any issue with our software that impairs the operation of a customer’s contact centre has significant financial ramifications for them. Our ability to restore service, improve their understanding, and resolve chronic issues will greatly increase the value they receive from our solutions and will reduce financial risk when they experience problems.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrate deep subject matter expertise in our core technologies, as well as at least one other technology specialty, and develop expertise in a second area of specialty.</li> <li>Provide advanced technical support to customers via phone, online, chat, and email and use tools and advanced expertise to pull and effectively analyse logs, traces, packet captures, etc. to determine root cause of issues.</li> <li>Demonstrate professional, assertive, articulate, and friendly verbal and written communication in all aspects of your work. Take full ownership of all communication needs related to the management of troubleshooting efforts internally and externally, building confidence across all customers and stakeholders that we are progressing properly towards resolution.</li> <li>Effectively mentor colleagues on their communication, troubleshooting, process, product knowledge and case work.</li> <li>Encourage productive debate and discussion with colleagues to more thoroughly analyse and resolve problems.</li> <li>Be influential in improving procedures and processes that improve our efficiency and effectiveness.</li> <li>Ensure that each case that you own is progressing according to the response and resolution targets as specified in our Service Level Agreements (SLA). Assist colleagues in accelerating their cases toward timely resolution.</li> <li>Provide root cause correction, not just symptom relief. Ensure that all facets of the problem are evaluated to eliminate the recurrence of the issue. Exemplify tenacity in resolving core issues that fully resolve problems and assist peers in doing the same.</li> <li>Proactively manage personally assigned and cases from the queue based upon severity and priority of each issue and your skills and ability to resolve.</li> <li>Open and monitor incidents created with 3rd party providers. Work with other internal stakeholders to improve our interactions and success in handling these incidents.</li> <li>Obtain and maintain certification as a Knowledge-Cantered Service (KCS) Publisher, create useful knowledge content, and update existing knowledgebase articles using KCS methodology. Provide coaching to others on KCS best practices.</li> <li>Identify, document, and report issues with software, design, reliability, and maintenance issues to the proper teams, ensuring that they are aware of and are addressing customer expectations. Gather, validate, and document all pertinent details related to an issue believed to be a bug to enable the receiving R&amp;D resource to duplicate the issue easily and rapidly. Work with R&amp;D as needed during isolation, correction, and implementation of any delivered resolution.</li> <li>Develop and maintain consistent and exemplary performance on all key performance indicators, modelling a higher-level achievement for level 1 Technical Support Engineers as well as your peers at the same job level.</li> <li>Properly de-escalate customers through expert communication and resource engagement, ensuring that all customers that you influence are receiving excellent service. Expected to handle more complex and escalated cases.</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep understanding of networking technologies and how they are utilized by our products, platform, and customers.
